name: LapCat2A v0.1.0 (test build)
body:
Test build of LapCat2A, a free open source optical leveling amplifier (VST3). Not tuned by ear and not tried on real machines yet.

In the zip: installers for Windows (.exe), macOS (.pkg) and Linux (Flatpak extension and a plain .vst3), the PDF manual, INSTALL.txt, LICENSE and SHA256SUMS. Everything works offline. No telemetry.

The installers are not signed or notarized, so your system may warn you. Windows: More info, then Run anyway. macOS: System Settings, Privacy and Security, Open Anyway. Details are in INSTALL.txt and the manual.

What is measured and what is not is listed in ROADMAP.md.
